title: Units comparison to the reduction is locally surjective
statement: Let $X$ be any scheme and $i:X_{\mathrm{red}}\to X$ its reduction [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction]. Write $\mathbf G_{m,X}$ for the sheaf of units [def-sc-gm-torsor] on the small etale site, as an abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. The canonical comparison $\varphi:i^{-1}\mathbf G_{m,X}\to\mathbf G_{m,X_{\mathrm{red}}}$, the transpose of restriction of units under the inverse-image/direct-image adjunction [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], is an epimorphism of abelian sheaves (every section locally lifts).

proof.text: The reduction map is a surjective closed immersion. More generally, a surjective morphism g:T → V reflects units of global functions: the inverse image of the basic open D(a) is D(g* a), and if g* a is a unit then this inverse image is all of T. Surjectivity forces D(a)=V, so every germ of a is a unit and a is a unit. This is the fully proved private helper isUnit_of_surjective_appTop; its last step uses Scheme.isUnit_of_basicOpen_eq_top, proved from the sheaf gluing criterion for units.

For a surjective closed immersion with affine target V, the affine characterization of closed immersions makes the map on global functions surjective. Lift the underlying function of a unit b to a. The preceding unit-reflection argument makes a a unit, yielding a preimage in the units group. Lean implements this as surjective_units_appTop using IsClosedImmersion.isAffine_surjective_of_isAffine and Units.ext.

For any etale object U over X, cover U by its affine open cover. After base change the reduction map to each cover member remains a surjective closed immersion. Apply affine unit lifting to the restriction of the given section of i_*G_m. Every arrow in the affine cover therefore belongs to its image sieve; the affine cover is jointly surjective, so the image sieve covers in the small etale topology. This is the fully proved helper locallySurjective_gmSheafToLowerStar_of_thickening. Local surjectivity implies that G_m,X → i_*G_m,X_red is epi.

Reduction is a universal homeomorphism, so both direct and inverse image are equivalences of abelian sheaf categories. Inverse image preserves epimorphisms and the counit of its adjunction with the fully faithful direct image is an isomorphism. By Adjunction.homEquiv_counit, the canonical comparison i^*G_m,X → G_m,X_red is inverse image applied to the preceding epi followed by that counit. Hence it is epi.
